entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you with an agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return for my VeloBand.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I ask, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a technical fault. The pulse reading is complete garbage. It's never accurate.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with the pulse accuracy. I might be able to help you fix that. Sometimes a quick software reset resolves calibration issues. Do you have the band nearby?
Look, I don't have time for all that. It doesn't work. I just want my money back. I want a refund, not a tech support session.
I understand completely. No problem at all. Let me just pull up your order to check the return eligibility. Can I have your email address, please?
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. Let me just check the policy here...
Alright, I've confirmed it. You are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you. I'm generating a prepaid shipping label to send to your email right now.
Once our warehouse receives the item, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment within 3 to 5 business days. You should see that email with the label in the next few minutes.
Perfect. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
